title: No-Bake Energy Bites
blurb: Quick energy balls made from crushed biscuits, nut butter and dried fruit, ready in minutes with no cooking required.
steps: Place the Graham crackers in a food processor and pulse until they form fine crumbs, or crush them in a sealed bag with a rolling pin.
Transfer the crumbs to a mixing bowl and add the peanut butter, honey, raisins and half the coconut flakes.
Mix everything together with a wooden spoon until well combined and the mixture holds together when pressed.
Roll the mixture into twelve balls, each about the size of a walnut, using damp hands to prevent sticking.
Spread the remaining coconut flakes on a plate and roll each ball in them to coat.
Place the energy bites on a plate and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.
